name: Cash Runway
description: A biotech-first financial planning console: reviewed actuals, rolling budgets, deterministic decision scenarios, monthly cash forecasts and management briefings, inspired by Jirav workflows.
whenToUse: Use when a biotech CFO, CEO or finance lead needs a lightweight, auditable cash-runway and spending plan with manual approved data and scenario simulation, without implementing an ERP.
whenNotToUse: Do not use as a general ledger, bank connection, tax/payroll app, full 3-statement Jirav alternative, regulated reporting system, patient-level database or model with mandatory cross-currency consolidation and unlimited source rows.

heading.description: App title shown in finance console.

currency.description: One reporting currency; no conversion is performed.

tableMap.description: JSON role mapping with real authorized UUID table IDs, field keys and writable logical keys.

pageSize.description: 10–50 approved records per page; template clamps bounds.

reserveThreshold.description: Planning reserve threshold in selected currency; explicit assumption.

cutoff.description: Optional approved actuals cutoff date YYYY-MM-DD; otherwise latest actual is used.

layoutProfile.description: JSON presentation profile saved by native Settings through reviewed, versioned app updates.

readOnly.description: Suppress all proposed writes when true.

demoLabel.description: Display clear demo mode warning for controlled preview only.

instructions: Read the current read_app_template_guidance usage and authoring pages to completion, read_app_design, list_app_templates and read_app_template. Pin this exact version and digest and use one requestKey. This is an internal TrialAgents app: use host accounts, permissions and the official linked watermark, with no app login or replacement logo. Preserve the six-screen finance design unless the user asks to change it. Read existing authorized schemas before proposing three role tables: ledger, scenarios, briefings. Use scalar fields; map logical names to real lowercase database keys in tableMap. Database types are text, number, money, date, boolean or select: source/notes/body/sources are text (not url/longtext). Map clinicalMultiplier to clinical_multiplier, peopleDelta to people_delta, contractorDelta to contractor_delta, fundingDelay to funding_delay and trialShift to trial_shift. Set writableFields to LOGICAL keys only for authorized manifest write fields. Include every displayed bound field in the versioned manifest with real schemaVersion, field kind and read/write mode; use workspace scope unless project-only data was requested. Include archived:boolean for reviewed soft deletion. Never seed demo data. Ask for reporting currency, opening start-of-day cash date, inclusive actuals cutoff and reserve; do not treat default reserve as an approved assumption. Exact current cash supports a partial-month cutoff; monthly forecasts require a complete month-end cutoff and plan coverage. Preview empty, small and bounded data in the actual QuickJS/sanitized host with manifest attached. Record form values are transient drafts marked data-ui-state, not committed records: submit calls records.propose; only the trusted confirmation receipt establishes a save. Duplicate creates a draft; Delete archives after review. Native Settings opens with tracker:layout; the declared templateLayoutSchema permits only reviewed presentation changes through prepare_tool_layout. Save and verify the existing app ID/version and reopen after layout changes. Revise the same app with expectedVersion; reconcile ambiguous receipts and never create a replacement app on retry. Retain bindings, permissions, assets, execution and disabled automation state. Custom screens have app-level access only. Save the app before any optional automation. Quietly read_automation_setup, read_app_automation_guide and list_app_automations; prepare_app_monitoring and a separate prepare_app_action only within the owner-authorized scope. No per-app host ChatGPT Task, no ChatGPT email sending. Report app save, definition state, runner readiness and delivery separately. Missing setup never blocks the app.

quickStart: Read current authoring/usage/design guidance and exact template version/digest. Preserve the official host watermark; no app-local auth.

Inspect authorized schemas and bind ledger/scenarios/briefings. Use scalar platform types and real lowercase field keys; map logical camelCase scenario keys explicitly. Review required schema changes and manifest read/write modes.

Obtain one reporting currency, start-of-day opening balance/date, inclusive actuals cutoff and reserve assumption. Forecasts require a reviewed month-end cutoff plus monthly budgets; missing values remain unavailable.
Prepare one app using the same requestKey, real tableMap/bindings and manifest. Test all six screens in the production frame; fictional demo records are never saved.
Approve and reconcile the saved app ID/version. Verify entry, editing, duplication and reviewed archive; verify denied writes remain unsaved.

Open the settings gear, drag or select source/destination handles to reorder screens/fields, review and confirm layout, then reopen. Ignore retains the previous layout. Layout never changes data access.
Optionally configure the separately reviewed monthly ChatGPT briefing and dependent TrialAgents email described in tasks. No automation is a fully supported default.
documentation.dataContract: Three scalar role tables, with required name:text. Ledger: kind:select [opening,actual_out,actual_in,budget_out,budget_in,funding_in], period:date, amount:money nonnegative, currency:text, program:text, category:text, commitment:select [Committed,Discretionary,Contingent], vendor:text, source:text (HTTPS reference), notes:text, archived:boolean. Require kind/period/amount/currency for ledger creation. Scenarios: name:text, clinical_multiplier:number, people_delta:money (signed), contractor_delta:money (signed), funding_delay:number, trial_shift:number, reserve:money, cutoff:date, notes:text, archived:boolean. Briefings: name:text, period:date, cutoff:date, status:select [Draft,In review,Approved], author:text, body:text, sources:text, archived:boolean. All fields are multiple:false. Map logical scenario keys clinicalMultiplier/peopleDelta/contractorDelta/fundingDelay/trialShift to these real snake_case fields through tableMap; other keys map directly. tableMap is a JSON string with {ledger:{typeId:<real UUID>,fields:{name:"name",...},writableFields:[<logical keys>]},scenarios:{...},briefings:{...}}. Include every mapped field in bindings and manifest using the actual table version and kind; no account-specific IDs in examples. Opening is the latest valid start-of-day cash balance on or before the inclusive cutoff; only actuals on/after that opening date and on/before cutoff count. The whole date matters. Future opening balances are excluded. Partial-month cutoffs show exact current cash but withhold monthly forecast/runway until reviewed month-end actuals are available. Invalid dates, absent opening or truncated reads prevent exact cash claims. Budgets and Committed financing drive the future monthly model; Contingent financing is excluded. Each role reads at most 800 rows and flags incomplete coverage. Mixed currency is excluded and flagged, never converted. Duplicate actual/opening/funding resets to discretionary budget_out draft. Delete proposes archived:true, preserving identity/history. Authorizations are inherited from TrialAgents; no local account table. Draft form state and scenario calculations are local until an exact reviewed write succeeds. Layout profile is persisted in versioned app configuration, not in records.
documentation.interactionContract: Six screens retain the finance workflow: overview, ledger, budget, scenarios, forecast, briefings. Ledger search/filter/pagination and Edit/Duplicate/Delete menus operate on authorized records. All editable form inputs hold transient UI drafts with data-ui-state and distinct draft actions; none commits on input/change. Save submits exact records.propose changes to the trusted host for review. Scenario driver inputs are local assumptions until an approved scenario record save. Delete is a confirmed reviewed archive, not permanent removal. The gear emits tracker:layout to the native platform Settings editor. It reads the JSON templateLayoutSchema declaration, supports screen/field dragging and keyboard/touch pick-and-place, visibility and heading. Review/Confirm persists only layoutProfile/heading through expectedVersion; Ignore discards. Screen hiding never enforces access. Optional automation is managed in platform Automations and outcomes in Logs, never in this app. Production branding is the official linked host watermark.
documentation.lifecycle: Pin immutable life.cash-runway@1.2.2 and its catalog digest. Review schema/bindings and save once with the original requestKey. Reconcile app ID/version and receipts; revise existing app with expectedVersion, never create a second app to repair a response. Forms are draft state; proposal success is not a commit. Record edits retain the version read when the editor opened. Native layout saves preserve source logic, bindings, manifest, assets, execution, app identity and access; stale saves fail. Reopen from saved source so layoutProfile is authoritative, not stale input.state. Review/Ignore applies to presentation only. Disabled automations remain disabled; archiving suspends and restore/copy never activates work. Preserve published content and user input on background failure; no required runner/connector for ordinary use.
limitations: Custom screens use app-level access; hiding screens or columns does not change server permissions.

Calculation reads are bounded to 800 rows per role. Missing/invalid dates, missing opening or partial reads withhold cash; incomplete budgets withhold the affected forecast. Partial-month actuals require a month-end close before monthly runway is available.
One reporting currency, no bank feed, FX conversion, tax/payroll or accounting reconciliation. Opening balance is start-of-day; source approval and cutoff are owner-reviewed inputs.
Delete is reversible archived:true, not permanent database deletion. Restore through authorized database edits/history.
Native custom layout requires the host custom-layout support delivered with this release. A catalog-only deployment to an older host is insufficient. Settings edits presentation only.
Automation is optional and separately approved; enabled is not runner readiness. Pending setup or delivery failure never blocks the app. Requested model preferences are not verified host settings.

The standalone HTML is a fictional interaction demo with a local review simulation; the native settings and actual authorization paths are tested through the host. The production watermark comes from TrialAgents.

examples.prompt: Create Cash Runway for our biotech, use EUR, connect approved finance tables, and show the six-screen financial planner with editable ledger and scenario drivers. No automation yet.
examples.expectedBehavior: One version-pinned financial planning app, only authorized data, app-level access review, all six finance-specific screens, no background jobs and no fictional saved records.

examples.prompt: Duplicate the approved October CRO budget line, revise it for November, and remove the mistaken draft line.
examples.expectedBehavior: The duplicate opens a safe prefilled create proposal; the removal is a reviewed archived=true update, not irreversible deletion; source IDs and history stay auditable.

examples.prompt: Configure a monthly finance briefing via ChatGPT, then email me only after a reviewed new briefing is successfully saved.
examples.expectedBehavior: After the app is saved, prepare one monthly shared-runner ChatGPT research definition and one separately reviewed dependent TrialAgents email action. Record enabled and runner readiness separately; zero new reports means no email.

examples.prompt: Reorder the cash planner fields from Settings by dragging and preserve the layout for the team.
examples.expectedBehavior: Native settings lets the user drag or pick-and-place screens/fields; Review then Confirm saves the same app with expectedVersion. Reopening preserves order. Ignore and stale saves cannot overwrite configuration.

tasks.whenUseful: Optional, NOT activated: a monthly shared-ChatGPT-runner briefing based on approved new actuals; attach a separately approved TrialAgents email action after verified committed work, never a second independent schedule. Alternative no-automation manual usage is fully supported.
tasks.readRequirements: Authorize read of complete bounded pages of the app ledger, scenarios and briefings; current owner and AI access; exact finance source rows/versions/cutoff; no PHI; stable authoring keys life.cash-runway.monthly-board-briefing.v1 and life.cash-runway.email.after-briefing.v1; time zone Europe/Berlin only after owner approval. Contingent funding, mixed currencies and missing periods must be called out, never silently filled. No standing write grant without separate specific approval.
tasks.outputContract: ChatGPT must reconcile the authoritative saved briefing ID, data cutoff, committed receipt, count of changes and server-generated UTC update-completed timestamp. `no_update` when no new approved actuals and owner opted for quiet behavior; no email. Denied/failed/partial/unapproved report: no success declaration or email. TrialAgents email action uses a MANUAL after-success dependent trigger, approved registered recipients with current access and trusted current app URL. Preserve receipts across email failures and do not rerun research for email retry. Completion outcomes go to platform Logs, not in-app banners.
tasks.promptExample:
Every month on the first business day after approved actuals are available (Europe/Berlin), check this app for a new approved actuals cutoff later than the last successfully briefed cutoff. Read complete authorized ledger, scenario and briefing pages; respect every app/database permission and the 800-row calculation limit. Check source currency, opening-balance date, forecast coverage and scenario assumptions. Recompute cash roll-forward and scenario shortfalls deterministically; compare with prior approved report. Do not create a report if no approved new data: return no_update and the most recent successful check. If new approved data exist, draft a concise board-finance briefing with exact cutoff, currency, source record IDs, finance reference URLs where present, evidence dates, gap flags, budget versus actual variances, cash reserve exposure and explicit decisions. Propose ONE new Draft briefing using a stable dedup key of app ID + cutoff + report type; do not change or delete actuals. Save only under the owner's existing approved write scope or ask for exact review; reconcile the committed write receipt and report ID before completing. A partial, denied, duplicate or unapproved run must not trigger an email. ChatGPT must not send email.

Email action (only after separate approval): After a verified successful Cash Runway monthly briefing research run has committed a new reviewed briefing record, email the app owner and separately approved registered team members with current access only. Subject: Cash Runway finance briefing ready — {verified_cutoff}. Body: The {verified_cutoff} briefing is available in TrialAgents. A reviewed record was saved at {server_update_completed_at_utc}; {saved_changes} record(s) committed. {one_sentence_verified_summary}. Open {trusted_current_app_link}. Do not send if saved_changes=0, no_update, pending review, denied/failed/partial work, stale access, missing validated completion timestamp, or unknown result. Use TrialAgents email action executor with manual after-success dependency; no independent email calendar schedule and never an email/ChatGPT connector from the template.

No automation path: Create the Cash Runway using reviewed finance tables and no automations. Users enter opening balance, actuals, budgets and scenario drivers; saved data and all six screens work without background services, external connectors or scheduled email.
